sections.heading: 1 Participants and covered activities
sections.text: Ground-Based Mobility Flow classes, private lessons and supervised practice at 2029 Mt. Diablo Blvd, Walnut Creek, CA 94596, provided by the Studio or Uriel E. Arauz. sections.heading: 2 Voluntary participation and personal boundaries
sections.text: Participation is voluntary. I may decline a movement, partner interaction, contact or hands-on adjustment, or pause or stop at any time. I will tell the instructor when I need a modification or do not want contact. Instructors cannot guarantee that an activity is suitable for me.

sections.heading: 3 Activities and inherent risks
sections.text: Ground-Based Mobility Flow may include floor work, crawling, low transitions, balance, loaded joint positions, controlled ranges of motion and inversions when offered. Risks include falls, loss of balance, pressure on joints, strains and discomfort or injury to wrists, shoulders, hips, knees, neck or back. I will not force a range of motion or work through pain; I may request modifications or stop. Floors, bare feet, footwear and equipment affect grip, turning and balance.

I will follow safety guidance, stay within my skill level, use appropriate clothing and footwear, stay home when unwell or contagious, and stop and notify the instructor if dizzy, unwell or injured. All Practices Participant Waiver

2029 Mt. Diablo Blvd, Walnut Creek, CA 94596

1 Participants and covered activities
This agreement applies to participation in the Studio's current practices, classes, private lessons, supervised practice, socials, workshops and community activities at 2029 Mt. Diablo Blvd, Walnut Creek, CA 94596, including Capoeira, Salsa, Samba, Ground-Based Mobility, Yoga and related movement, music and cultural activities. It also applies to future Studio-operated practices within the scope of the activities and risks described in this agreement. Materially different activities or risks may require an updated or supplemental agreement. It applies to new and current students, members, drop-ins and free trials, and to studio-controlled practice and common areas while arriving, attending and leaving. Covered services include Capoeira and Mobility provided there by Uriel E. Arauz and Salsa provided there by Luis Aguilar or Couture Dance Alliance (CDA). Independently operated programs retain their own provider agreements. For independently operated Samba or another outside program not specifically covered above, this Studio agreement addresses only the named Released Parties' own premises, services and conduct. It does not release that independent provider or replace that provider's agreement. Off-site activities, independent rentals, childcare and areas outside Studio control are excluded.

2 Voluntary participation and personal boundaries
Participation is voluntary. I may decline a movement, partner interaction, contact or hands-on adjustment, or pause or stop at any time. I will tell the instructor when I need a modification or do not want contact. Instructors cannot guarantee that an activity is suitable for me.

3 Activities and inherent risks
Capoeira may involve kicks, sweeps, acrobatics, inversions, floor work, close interaction in the roda, music and instruments. Salsa and Samba may involve vigorous footwork, turns and close proximity; Salsa may include partner work. Mobility Flow and Yoga may involve loaded joints, balance, stretching, floor work, low transitions and inversions. Risks include accidental contact, collisions, falls, hard landings, joint stress and injury to limbs, neck or head. These examples are not exhaustive. Physical exertion may also cause fatigue, dizziness, strains, sprains, fractures, concussion, permanent disability or death. Floors, bare feet, footwear and equipment affect grip, turning and balance.

4 Assumption of inherent risks
I understand that inherent risks can cause injury or loss even when reasonable care is used. I knowingly and voluntarily choose to participate and assume the inherent risks of the covered activities. This does not waive claims that California law does not allow to be waived.

5 Participation responsibilities
I will consider whether I can safely participate and seek medical advice when needed. I will share relevant limitations privately with my instructor; no medical history is required on this form. I will follow safety guidance, stay within my skill level, use appropriate clothing and footwear, stay home when unwell or contagious, and stop and notify the instructor if dizzy, unwell or injured. I will report hazards and keep belongings clear of practice areas. The Studio does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment or secure storage. Participation may be paused or ended for safety.

6 Limited release of ordinary negligence claims
In consideration of being allowed to participate or use the covered areas, I release Roots Legacy Ventures LLC dba Roots & Wisdom Studio (the Studio); Claudia Aguilar; Uriel E. Arauz individually and dba Sitio Alegre Capoeira; Luis Aguilar; and Couture Dance Alliance (CDA) solely for its role in covered Salsa activities; and their instructors, staff, contractors and agents only while acting for the Studio or the named provider in the covered activities (the Released Parties). This release covers claims for injury, illness, death or property loss arising from covered participation or use of studio-controlled areas, floors or equipment, only to the extent based on a Released Party's ordinary negligence and permitted by California law. Examples include ordinary negligence in instruction, supervision, inspection or maintenance. An independent provider not named here is not automatically released. Claudia Aguilar and Uriel E. Arauz are named in their roles teaching, assisting instruction, supervising, handling registration and check-in, organizing activities and supporting studio operations. Authorized instructors, staff, contractors and assistants are included only while acting for the Studio or the named provider in the covered activities.

Limits of the release
THIS RELEASE DOES NOT COVER GROSS NEGLIGENCE, FRAUD, WILLFUL INJURY OR MISCONDUCT, VIOLATION OF LAW, OR ANY CLAIM OR LIABILITY THAT CANNOT LAWFULLY BE WAIVED.

7 Parent or legal guardian consent
For a participant under 18, I confirm that I am the named child's parent or legal guardian with authority to sign. I understand the activities and risks, consent to participation, and will explain safety expectations and share relevant limitations. To the extent California law permits, I agree to the assumption of risk and limited release on the child's behalf and release my own claims on the same limited basis. Claims that cannot lawfully be waived remain unaffected. Each child has a separate signed record. Each adult, including a spouse or partner, signs for themselves. A child turning 18 must sign their own adult waiver before further participation.

8 Emergency assistance
I authorize staff to contact the emergency contact and call emergency services when reasonably necessary. For a minor, staff may seek emergency medical evaluation if the guardian cannot promptly be reached, subject to applicable law. Staff are not medical providers and do not guarantee a particular response. Outside medical charges remain subject to the provider's terms and applicable law.

9 Duration and other agreements
This agreement applies from signing to future covered participation until replaced or withdrawn in writing to hello@rootsandwisdomstudio.com. Withdrawal does not undo earlier covered participation. It does not release claims for incidents before signing. Material changes in activities, operating entity or location may require a new or supplemental agreement. California law governs. If a provision is unenforceable, the rest applies to the extent permitted by law. Membership prices, recurring billing, cancellation, refunds and class policies remain in separate applicable agreements; this form does not change them.

10 Photo video and likeness release
The Studio takes photos and video footage during classes and events to advertise its classes and promote the studio. By signing this agreement, I grant Roots Legacy Ventures LLC dba Roots & Wisdom Studio the unrestricted right to photograph and record the participant and use the participant's image, likeness, voice and performance in photographs, video and digital media for advertising, promotional, marketing, educational and archival purposes, indefinitely and without compensation. I waive the right to inspect or approve the finished materials. For a minor, I give this permission as the parent or legal guardian. This release is part of the signed agreement, not a separate optional choice. For concerns or exceptions, contact the Studio before signing at hello@rootsandwisdomstudio.com. Any exception must be expressly agreed and recorded in writing.

11 Acknowledgment and signing
I have read and understand this entire agreement, including the limited liability release and the photo, video and likeness release, and have had an opportunity to ask questions. I sign voluntarily. For a child, I sign as the parent or legal guardian. If signing electronically, I consent to electronic records and signing and intend my typed full legal name together with my checked acceptance to be my electronic signature. I may save or print a copy; paper signing is available.
